description: This source file defines the 'SubUpdater' class, a Java actor class using Akka framework, responsible for managing local subscriptions in a distributed pub-sub system. It handles subscription requests, unsubscriptions, and synchronization with distributed data, with methods for creating actor properties, subscribing/unsubscribing, and performing distributed data operations.

classes.name: SubUpdater
classes.description: A generic Java actor class managing local subscriptions in a distributed pub/sub system, built on Akka, coordinating subscription state with distributed data and handling subscription lifecycle events.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object to instantiate the SubUpdater actor with specified configuration, subscriber reference, and distributed data.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles a subscription request, updates internal subscription state, enqueues request, and sets watch on subscriber if changed.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Handles an unsubscription request, updates internal state, enqueues request, and unwatches subscriber if no longer subscribed.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Handles success callback for distributed data operations, sends acknowledgments, and resets change flags.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs periodic distributed data update operations, with force update or based on local changes.

methods.name: flushSubAcks
methods.description: Sends subscription acknowledgement messages to the original senders.

methods.name: performDDataOp
methods.description: Performs distributed data operations such as updating or removing subscriptions, returning a snapshot of the current subscriptions state.
